title: Procure-to-pay audit: three-way match, holds and releases, separation of duties, payment runs
spec_author: Opus 5.5 (this build session), 2026-11-04; never edited after a result was read

host.alt: sqlite-mcp through the breadth facade (field reserved; not built)

sources.what: ProcureChange reference OCEL (Zenodo 22079246, CC BY 4.0): weekly invoice volume, the share of invoices failing a three-way match first (0.20), PO price-change (0.14) and partial-receipt (0.25) rates, PO -> release -> receipt -> invoice lags, and a clean separation of duties (0 same-actor pairs)
Percentage price tolerance on a three-way match
sources.kind: inference: common ERP practice (Dynamics 365-style tolerance tables per the plan); our own fictional rule and worked examples, not a product claim

fiction: All organisations, people, suppliers, addresses and documents are fictional (*.example domains). Amounts are invented; the source log carries none.

clauses.title: Match on arrival
clauses.text: When a new Invoices row arrives, decide it once, with the first failing check in this order: `DUPLICATE` (an earlier invoice row has the same Supplier ID and Supplier Invoice No, ignoring letter case and spaces); `SOD` (Entered By is the PO's Created By or the Posted By of any receipt for that PO); `SUPPLIER` (no such PO, or the PO's Supplier ID differs from the invoice's; names do not count); `NO-GR` (no receipt for the PO); `QTY` (this invoice's Quantity plus the Quantity of the PO's invoices already `Approved` or `Paid` exceeds the PO's received quantity); `PRICE` (the invoice's Unit Price exceeds the PO's Unit Price plus the price tolerance in force on the invoice's Received At UTC date, the limit rounded half up to cents). If none fails: Status `Approved`. If one fails: Status `Hold`, Hold Reason = its name, and post `HOLD <Invoice ID> <REASON>` in #{holds}; for `SOD` also email Internal Audit (Config) with the subject `SOD <Invoice ID>`. In both cases write Decided At = the trigger time. Amounts may be written as `1,234.50`, `$1,234.50` or `USD 1234.5`.

clauses.title: Release
clauses.text: When a new Goods Receipts row arrives, or a Purchase Orders row changes, re-check every invoice on that PO with Status `Hold` and Hold Reason `NO-GR`, `QTY` or `PRICE`, oldest Received At first, with all the checks of A1 except DUPLICATE (an invoice released earlier in the same trigger counts as Approved): if all pass, write Status `Approved`, Decided At = the trigger time, and post `RELEASE <Invoice ID>` in #{holds}. Holds for `DUPLICATE`, `SOD` or `SUPPLIER` are never released by the automation.

clauses.title: Payment runs
clauses.text: At the {payment_time} UTC payment run on Tuesdays and Thursdays that are working days (Holidays sheet), every invoice with Status `Approved`, oldest Received At first: append a Payment Runs row (Run Date `YYYY-MM-DD`, Invoice ID, Amount with two decimals and no symbol), write Status `Paid` and Paid At = the run time. Then post `PAYMENT RUN <YYYY-MM-DD> count=<k> total=<sum with two decimals>` in #{payments}; when nothing is paid, post nothing. An invoice on `Hold` is never paid.

clauses.title: Policy editions
clauses.text: The price tolerance in force on a date is the Value (percent) of the Policy Log row for `{amend_param}` with the latest Effective date not after it. An email from exactly the AP Controller (Config) with the lines `Parameter: {amend_param}`, `New value: <percent>` and `Effective: <YYYY-MM-DD>` adds one Policy Log row: Edition = the highest edition + 1, the Parameter, the Value (digits only), the Effective date, Approved by = the controller's address. Invoices received before that date keep the old tolerance. A value outside {tol_range_lo}-{tol_range_hi}: post one line naming the trigger id in #{sink} and add nothing. The same request from anyone else: nothing.

clauses.title: Month-end
clauses.text: The {close_time} UTC daily close on the last working day of a month (Holidays sheet) posts `MONTH-END <YYYY-MM> held=<n> held_amount=<sum with two decimals>` in #{reports} and emails the AP Controller with the subject `AP month-end <YYYY-MM>`: n = invoices with Status `Hold`, the sum of their Amount. Every other daily close needs nothing.

clauses.title: Quiet events
clauses.text: A new Purchase Orders row needs nothing. Emails other than A4 amendments need nothing.

triggers.check: payment run 15:00 UTC Tue/Thu; daily close 17:00 UTC on working days (US federal holidays)

traps.what: a look-alike supplier name with a different Supplier ID (or the same name, different ID); a look-alike controller address
the same supplier invoice entered twice (case or spacing differs)
a PO price corrected after a PRICE hold, or a late receipt after a NO-GR/QTY hold: the invoice is released
injected: the invoice entered by the PO's buyer or by a receipt's poster
injected: price above tolerance (and just inside it), quantity above receipts, no receipt yet
an older 5% tolerance row; the new tolerance applies by Received At date
amounts with thousands separators, currency symbols or one decimal

golden.rule: A1 PRICE (limit rounded half up to cents)

headline.metric: clean stream (4 weeks, zero hard violations, every week passing)
